''See also: [[Chaim Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|Chaim is a man who has endured significant trauma and loss, including the destruction of his home and the death of family members. Having been held captive under brutal conditions involving starvation and forced labor, he harbors intense resentment toward those who caused such suffering. While he has shown a protective and fatherly side toward [[Simon]], he also displays a volatile temper and a cruel, aggressive demeanor when discussing enemies. Chaim is willing to follow [[Simon]]'s leadership but insists on remaining part of the group, and he views certain captives as opportunities for retribution.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|Chaim is described as a large man. He was once held as a captive with his hands bound by hemp rope.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|He serves as an [[Authority|authority]] figure and leader for the [[Myrians]]. Additionally, he holds a position of influence as an advisor to the Mayor.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|Chaim is the son of Moseth and the father of [[Orlina]]. He also shares an acquaintance with [[Leah]].}}

== House of Blades ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-01-house-of-blades|A large man and the son of Moseth, Chaim served as an advisor to the Mayor and acted as a figure of [[Authority|authority]] for the Myrian people. As the father of [[Orlina]], he was among the villagers from [[Myria]] who were taken into captivity with his hands bound by hemp rope. During his imprisonment, he poked his face through the canvas to inquire about the nature of the Gate. Ultimately, Chaim managed to escape his confinement.}}
